entries.name: Medieval Madness

entries.name: Attack from Mars
entries.description: Defend Earth from Martian invaders in this beloved Bally classic.

entries.name: The Addams Family
entries.description: The best-selling pinball machine of all time. They're creepy and they're kooky.

entries.description: A magical journey through a world of illusions and mystery.

entries.description: The evolution of Galaxian. Challenge Stage still blows minds.
